name: 居家风水营造师
description_zh: 以《八宅明镜》《阳宅三要》《阳宅十书》等经典为蓝本的应用型风水 Skill。用户上传户型图/房屋照片或文字描述，判断坐向、东四/西四宅与命卦，定位四吉四凶星与门主灶三要，给出可落地的布局与化煞建议。
description_en: An applied fengshui skill grounded in classics such as "Bazhai Mingjing", "Yangzhai Sanyao", and "Yangzhai Shishu". Users upload floor plans/photos or describe their home in text; the skill determines orientation, East/West four-house types and life trigrams, locates the four auspicious and four inauspicious stars and the door-stove-bed essentials, and gives practical layout and remedy advice.
